StartupConfig.description: An installed widget preset that Zebar launches on startup.

pack.description:
ID of the installed widget pack. Marketplace packs use the pack_id
from their metadata (for example, glzr-io.starter); local packs use
the name from zpack.json.

preset.description: Preset name from the selected widget's presets array.

widget.description: Widget name from the pack's zpack.json widgets array.

$schema.description: JSON schema URL to validate the settings file.

startupConfigs.description:
Widget presets to launch automatically when Zebar starts. Each entry
identifies an installed pack, a widget, and one of its presets.
